player_prompt.intro:
I ye jɛgɛ {player_id} kɔnɔ IteratedTwoThirdsAverage jɛgɛ {num_rounds} kɔnɔ.
Kɔnɔ kɔnɔ, gɛlɛnɛ kɛnɛ jɛgɛ {min_guess} nɛ {max_guess} cɛma.
Gɛlɛnɛ filɛ, kɛnɛ jɛgɛ kɔnɔ kɔnɔ, kɛnɛ tɛmɛnɛnɛnɛ (2/3)x(kɛnɛ jɛgɛ filɛnɛnɛnɛ),
kɛnɛ jɛgɛ minɛnɛnɛ kɛnɛ tɛmɛnɛnɛnɛ jɛgɛ kɔnɔ.
Kɛlɛnɛnɛnɛnɛ kɛnɛ '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Forobakalan man ɲi; n'i b'a fɛ k'o jaabi lɔn, i ka sɛbɛ nin ci [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kà kɛ̀ɛ̀nɛ̀ donso sɔrɔ {min_guess} ka tɛmɛ {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Jokelaso 0 da {guess0}; Jokelaso 1 da {guess1}. O donso, Nɛgɛla ye: {target}.
message.round_draw: A laban ye bɛnbaliya lo ye.

outcome.p0_wins: Ɲiningali 0 ye se sɔrɔ siɲɛ caaman.
outcome.p1_wins: Ɲiningali 1 ye see sɔrɔ siɲɛ caaman.
outcome.draw: A laban, u bɛɛ bɔnɛna wari la.
